title: Library
intro: Secondary literature on Spacewar!: the work the group reads and cites.

items.title: Space Odyssey: The Long Journey of Spacewar! from MIT to Computer Labs Around the World
items.author: Monnens, Devin; Goldberg, Martin
items.note: Kinephanos, Cultural History of Video Games special issue, pp. 124-147. Surveys how Spacewar! spread from the MIT PDP-1 to other laboratories and machines between 1962 and 1972, from DECUS records, questionnaires and correspondence with programmers. Table 1 lists known versions.

items.title: 12. Video games 1: Spacewar
items.author: Isaacson, Walter
items.note: Recorded lecture for a Tulane University course on the digital revolution, the first of two on video games. The whole lecture is on Spacewar!. 12:46.

items.title: Steven Johnson on "Spacewar!"
items.author: Johnson, Steven
items.note: Clip from the Q&A after the Long Now seminar "Wonderland: How Play Made the Modern World", with Stewart Brand as questioner. 3:15.

items.title: Episode 8: The PDP-1 and Spacewar!
items.author: Codex Rex: The Video Game History Podcast
items.note: Dachz tells co-host Tyler the story of DEC, Ben Gurley, the PDP-1 and Spacewar!. Spacewar! begins at 36:28. 56:12.

items.title: Episode 11 - Spacewar! (the Game)
items.author: Advent of Computing
items.note: Computing-history podcast episode on Spacewar! as an answer to when and how video games started. 24:45.

items.title: Spacewar! Or, the Rise of the Computer Bums
items.author: Dunavin, Davis
items.note: Public-radio feature for WSHU's Off the Path, in a season on the origins of things that are ubiquitous. 16:53.

items.title: The Meeting of Spacewar
items.author: They Create Worlds (podcast)
items.note: Episode 081, with Alexander Smith, on the history of Spacewar!, the people involved and the 2018 Smithsonian reunion of its makers. 81:57.

items.title: Ep. 31: Spacewar!: Dual to the Death
items.author: Video Game History Hour (podcast)
items.note: With Alexander Smith as guest, on who wrote Spacewar!, who modified it, who played it and who made the first controllers. 93:31.

items.title: Thumb Candy - The history of computer games
items.author: Talkback (for Channel 4)
items.note: Channel 4 documentary presented by Iain Lee. The Spacewar! segment opens the programme, 1:49 to 5:43, with Steve Russell. 48:34.

items.title: Video Game Invasion: The History of a Global Obsession
items.author: Hawk, Tony (host)

items.title: Video Games: The Movie, clip: Spacewars

items.title: Personal Computer Graphics of the 60s and 70s
